adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the caller to be both a team admin and a team owner to pass that branch. That is almost certainly an authorization logic error for a role gate named/used like “admin or owner”, and it will deny legitimate team admins who are not owners.
